item.title: feat(ui): show online people and session activity (#125695)
item.summary: feat(ui): show online people and session activity (#125695) * feat(ui): add sidebar Online presence section and Activity session feed Adds a sidebar "Online" section (visible only when at least one other identity is connected, idle users dimmed) that links into a new session-feed default view on the existing Activity page: search, time window, and per-person facets over day-grouped sessions, with a per-person identity header (devices, viewing-now) when one person is selected. Removes the dead footer viewer-facepile roster that the sidebar-zone refactor (#112936) left unmounted. Client-only; no gateway/protocol changes. * test(ui): make activity capture date-boundary safe
